definitions.short: to wag the tongue , i.e. to calumniate
definitions.full: H3960. lashan [ לָשַׁן ] verb denominative use the tongue , only specifically, slander ; — Po`el Participle רֵעֵהוּ בַּסֵּתֶד מְלָו֯שְׁנִי Psa 101:5 (on form, compare Ges § 90 , 3 Kö Lgb. i. § 26 ). Hiph`il Imperfect 2masculine singular jussive וגו עֶבֶד ׳אַלתַּֿלְשֵׁן Prov 30:10 .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to lick; but used only as a denominative from 3956 ;
